subject: Need to move our call
text: I need to reschedule our call. I looked again at the calendar. I had entered the wrong date. The request still seemed reasonable to me, but the slot was not confirmed as I first believed. I do not want to cause any inconvenience. Could we move it to later in the week? Any afternoon after two would suit me. If that is difficult, I can accept another time, so long as it falls before Friday. I am sorry for the confusion. It was my mistake. I value your time, and I prefer not to overlap with your existing plans. Please let me know what works. I will send a revised invitation once we agree. I will also keep the original note deleted to avoid further doubt. Thank you.
